leaves.name: dsThm965Printed
leaves.doc: Diamond-Shurman, GTM 228 (2005), Thm 9.6.5 (k >= 2; Deligne 1971; Shimura 1971 Thm 7.14 for k = 2; numbering UNVERIFIED), printed form: for a normalized eigenform f in S_k(N, chi) (DS Def 5.8.1) with number field K_f and a prime lambda of O_{K_f} over l, a continuous rho_{f,lambda} : G_Q -> GL_2(K_{f,lambda}) (Mathlib's adicCompletion), unramified outside lN, with rho(Frob_p) having characteristic polynomial (or satisfying) x^2 - a_p x + chi(p) p^(k-1) over K_f. Either printed wording gives it by or-introduction; no coefficient dictionary (coeff-ext).
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (DS 9.6.5 over K_{f,lambda} as printed, DS Def 5.8.1 eigenforms, either wording by or-introduction); locator UNVERIFIED
leaves.source: Diamond-Shurman, GTM 228, Thm 9.6.5 (Deligne 1971; Shimura 1971 Thm 7.14 for k = 2), printed form over K_{f,lambda}: rho_{f,lambda}(Frob_p) has characteristic polynomial (or satisfies) x^2 - a_p x + chi(p) p^(k-1)

leaves.name: eigenformCoeffFieldFinite
leaves.doc: K_f = Q(a_n(f)) is a number field for a normalized eigenform f in S_k(N, chi), k >= 2 (DS Def 5.8.1): Diamond-Shurman Thm 6.5.1 for k = 2; Shimura 1971 Thm 3.52 with the Hecke stability of the rational structure for general k (numbers UNVERIFIED). Presupposed by DS 9.6.5 ('with number field K_f') (coeff-ext).
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (K_f a number field; DS 6.5.1 prints k = 2, Shimura 1971 Thm 3.52 the rational structure for every k); locator UNVERIFIED
leaves.source: Diamond-Shurman, GTM 228, Thm 6.5.1 (k = 2); Shimura 1971, Thm 3.52 and section 3.5 (every k): K_f is a number field

leaves.name: dsThm966Printed
leaves.doc: Deligne-Serre, Formes modulaires de poids 1, Ann. Sci. ENS (4) 7 (1974), Thm 4.1 with (4.1.1), p. 514 (locator UNVERIFIED); Diamond-Shurman Thm 9.6.6: for a normalized eigenform f in S_1(N, chi) (DS Def 5.8.1) a continuous rho_f : G_Q -> GL_2(C) with finite image, unramified outside N, tr rho_f(Frob_p) = a_p(f), det rho_f(Frob_p) = chi(p). DSThm966 with the Diamond-Shurman definition of normalized eigenform (equivalent: DSCoeffExt.dsThm966Printed_of_dsThm966) (coeff-ext).
